source.why_this_clip: A white mug with a dark leaf pattern and a handle on the right, filled with a dark drink, seen from slightly above against a dark ground. The mug does not move; the camera slowly pushes in. The cut is at 4.0 to 4.25 s and earlier the cup jumps in and out of frame, so this interval starts after the cut and ends before the push-in crops the handle.
